concepts.title: Environment: Functions and Resource Depletion
concepts.definition: Environment supplies resources, absorbs waste, sustains life and provides aesthetic services; resource depletion arises when extraction exceeds regeneration and waste generation exceeds absorption capacity, threatening the carrying capacity of the environment.
concepts.key_idea: Sustainable development meets the needs of the present generation without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs.
question_patterns: define environment and state its four functions
what is carrying capacity of the environment
explain resource depletion and its causes
how does waste absorption capacity get exceeded
distinguish renewable and non renewable resources

solution_steps.explain: Note which environmental service is in use.
Check extraction against regeneration and waste against absorption.
Judge whether present use shortchanges future generations.

concepts.title: Global Warming, Ozone Depletion and Pollution
concepts.definition: Environmental degradation includes global warming from greenhouse gases like carbon dioxide and methane, ozone depletion from chlorofluorocarbons thinning the protective ozone layer, and air, water, land and noise pollution from industrial and household wastes.
concepts.key_idea: The Kyoto Protocol sets emission reduction targets for greenhouse gases, and control measures cover cleaner fuels, catalytic converters and treatment of effluents.
question_patterns: explain global warming and the greenhouse effect
how does ozone depletion occur and why is it harmful
what are the measures to control environmental degradation
state the role of the kyoto protocol
which gases are responsible for the greenhouse effect

solution_steps.explain: Separate warming, ozone loss and pollution types.
Note greenhouse gases, CFCs or waste streams.

concepts.title: Strategies for Sustainable Development in India
concepts.definition: Sustainable development strategies include use of non-conventional energy like solar, wind and hydel power, cleaner LPG and gobar gas, compressed natural gas in transport, bio composting, biopesticides, traditional knowledge and prudent water and forest use.
concepts.key_idea: Shifting from fossil fuels to renewable energy and recycling resources keeps development within environmental limits.
question_patterns: list the strategies for sustainable development
how do non conventional energy sources help sustainability
why is organic or bio composting sustainable
explain the use of cng in transport for cleaner air
how does traditional knowledge support sustainability
state the role of solar and wind energy in india

solution_steps.explain: Note the energy, input or practice change.
Confirm reduced fossil use or recycling.
